<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/api/debug/control"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Sends a control command (continue, step over/in/out, or stop) to an
active debug session, optionally updating its breakpoints first, and
returns the next debug event. Stopping a session tears it down
immediately and returns a synthetic terminated event.
